name: Taiwan Biyori Tabi yori
original_name: 台湾日和 たびより
source:
Shuuji is lonely and self-conscious about the fact that he's still single.

His friend suggests that he take a vacation to Taiwan, and offers a guide to Taipei's many gay bars.

Shuuji's nervous about traveling outside Japan for the first time, but he ends up meeting three friendly, good-looking guys. Maybe finding romance will be easier than he hoped.
